CharString pushes integer 2 (n=2) then issues blendcs (0x10) then endchar (0x14). No values are pushed for blending, so argStack will have only 1 element (the n value) when blendcs executes.
CFF2 table is parsed. Since vstoreOffset=0, varStore points to Null(CFF2VariationStore), so region_count will be 0.
process_blend initializes region_count from varStore. With Null variation store, region_count becomes 0.
k = region_count = 0. This is the number of variation regions.
n = 2, popped from the argStack. This is the number of default values to blend.
start = 1 - ((0+1)*2) = 1 - 2 = 0xFFFFFFFF (unsigned integer underflow). argStack has only 1 element (the n value was popped, leaving 0 elements, but get_count is called before pop).
